objective: Operationalize Part 5 as an occasional evidence-based quality check across system/profile reasoning, artifact/code consistency and real profile performance without granting an audit self-mutation authority.

constraints.text: Reasoning integrity, artifact/code consistency and profile performance must remain separate audit dimensions.
Reuse existing Reasoning Auditor and Profile Performance Auditor instead of creating a redundant mega-auditor profile.
Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN/PARTIAL and all improvement proposals remain PENDING_MAIN_HOST.
constraints.provenance: existing audit governance + Part 5 acceptance criteria

constraints.text: Do not invent an automatic audit cadence from the current small evidence base.
constraints.provenance: Part 5 roadmap note + observed three-record sample

claims.text: The runtime now has an on-demand quality-audit evidence/validation engine exposed through workspace_ctl.py quality-audit.

The first live Part 5 audit sampled all three available material decision records, produced a schema-valid PARTIAL report and left profile performance UNKNOWN because real completed-session evidence was absent.
The audit contract structurally prevents automatic integration and preserves the three required dimensions.

alternatives.option: Create one new system_quality_auditor profile that duplicates all audit responsibilities.
alternatives.reason: Duplicates existing specialist auditors and weakens responsibility boundaries.

alternatives.option: Automatically run an audit every fixed number of days or sessions immediately.
alternatives.reason: The current evidence base is too small to justify a cadence without invention.

alternatives.option: Collapse all quality evidence into one aggregate score.
alternatives.reason: Reasoning, artifact consistency and profile performance have different evidence and failure causes.

alternatives.option: Use an on-demand system function that reuses specialist auditors plus deterministic consistency checks.
alternatives.reason: Smallest non-duplicative architecture satisfying Part 5 acceptance criteria.

decision: Adopt periodic_quality_audit_policy with manual/on-demand invocation, quality_audit.py evidence preparation and deterministic consistency checks, existing reasoning_auditor/profile_performance_auditor ownership, a three-dimension aggregate report, and strict PENDING_MAIN_HOST/self-audit boundaries.

unknowns.text: Actual performance of individual workflow profiles remains unmeasured until completed-session evidence is collected.
unknowns.provenance: first Part 5 audit found no completed profile-performance reports

unknowns.text: No automatic cadence is justified yet; future cadence should depend on observed audit cost, recurrence and usefulness.
